gaps.explanation: p4 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis, Governmental Funds prints three fund columns (General, Special Revenue, Debt Service). detail[] has the General Fund (p7) and Special Revenue Fund (p8) budget schedules only; the Debt Service Fund has no schedule and none of its lines are in detail. Debt Service Fund column p4: Property taxes 133,751 + Homestead exemption 6,114 + Motor vehicle prorate 321 = 140,186 (= gap; its printed Total revenues collected 140,187 also includes Transfers in 1, see note). Check: 866,751 + 140,186 = 1,006,937 = statement total. Note: the same column also prints Transfers in 1 (inside its revenue total); there is no transfers gap row for this report, so it is not added here (adding it would make the detail net transfers 0, as the p4 Total column prints '-').
